title: Amazon Metric1 High Value Outliers
dataSources: Gift registries (`gift:registry`), Amazon wishlists (`amazon:wishlist`), holiday card sends (`holiday:card`), birthday budgets (`birthday:budget`), and thank-you notes (`thankyou:note`).
app: Gift registry exports, Amazon wishlist snapshots, holiday card mail logs, birthday budget trackers, and thank-you note reminders ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=amazon:metric1 value=*
| eventstats perc90(value) as p90, perc10(value) as p10
| where value>=p90 OR value<=p10
| table _time source_id value p90 p10
description: Surfaces the highest and lowest value outliers in amazon metric1 (1) events.
value: Tail events often explain spikes in cost, effort, or risk that averages hide.
implementation: Compute percentile bands on `value` and review extreme amazon metric1 (1) records.
visualization: Scatter plot of value with percentile bands.
grandmaExplanation: It scans the unusually high or low value moments in your amazon metric1 (1) history.
